Do not use isolated islands or thermal spokes. Keep other-net copper/antipads away; verify filled CAM, not zone outline alone.

mask.top_EP: 1.68 x1.68 R0.05 EP expanded .05 mm and unioned with four .64 mm via openings; no internal mask islands.
mask.top_peripheral: Each corrected .60 x.24 R0.05 pad expanded .05 mm.
mask.bottom: Four independent .70 mm openings at via centers. Larger than top because there are no bottom signal-pad mask webs to protect.
mask.bottom_change_reason: Symmetric .64 mm openings miss the conservative independent .075 mm/axis and .43 mm hole envelope by 1.066 um radially; .70 mm bottom openings retain 28.934 um before unknown mask-registration error.
mask.manufacturing_instruction: Retain explicit local TOP .64 mm openings; automatic CAM expansion to .70 mm at TOP would destroy the intended >=.10 mm mask bridge. Confirm production artwork. A nominal bridge is not a registration guarantee.

paste.peripheral: Use automatic TOP paste at zero expansion on the 16 corrected rounded-rectangle pads, giving 1:1 .60 x.24 R0.05 openings.

remove_existing_top_paste.instruction: Resolve actual instance artwork IDs by layer/local geometry; delete all old U101 TOP_PASTE_MASK fills before enabling peripheral automatic paste and adding the new central polygon. Do not assume source e20..e36 IDs survive import.

paste.EP_auto_paste: Disable explicitly using supported native expansion/shape controls (existing footprint uses approximately -100 mm suppression); do not leave an automatic EP opening under this polygon. Verify actual export is exactly the intended union.
paste.construction: [-.775,.775]^2 minus four (centered .210 x.210 squares Minkowski-summed with a radius-.255010 mm disk). Circumscribe disk arcs using radius/cos(pi/(4*128)); round final vertices to9 decimals. Cutout squares combine .03 print and .075 drill per-axis translation. Radius combines .43/2 max hole, .02 outward aperture error, .02 residual clearance and .000010 computational reserve.
paste.polygon_closure: Implicit last-to-first; coordinate list has no repeated endpoint.
paste.difference_from_TI_stencil_example: TI page54 shows an unrelieved 1.55 mm square with 0.125 mm stencil and about85% area. This project uses a .10 mm stencil and hole-avoidance relief, about51% nominal; it is a prototype assembly candidate, not that TI example or certified minimum solder coverage.

tolerance_assumptions.stencil_020_status: Project acceptance bound, not a supplier guarantee. Current public stencil process page did not expose a contractual edge-tolerance number. Confirm actual aperture/print geometry.
tolerance_assumptions.hole_source: https://jlcpcb.com/capabilities/pcb-capabilities publishes +/-0.075 hole position and +.13/-.08 PTH size; exact axis interpretation and drill/copper correlation are unspecified. Domestic https://www.jlc.com/portal/1/serviceGuide distinguishes insertion PAD compensation from conducting VIA processing. The .43/max and per-axis envelope is a conservative scenario, not a demonstrated domestic VIA guarantee.
tolerance_assumptions.copper_etch_tolerance_model: Not established as a same-layer pad/via acceptance bound here; artwork spacing checks only.
tolerance_assumptions.manual_registration: User has magnification, but availability does not measure achievement of +/-30um local registration. Inspect after each tape-hinge print; no geometric model of paste slump, transfer loss, molten solder wicking or board/stencil distortion.

recalculated_geometry.method: Fresh Shapely construction from manufacturer dimensions and this plan's coordinate list; no KiCad geometry/results imported. Continuous Minkowski translation envelopes, not corner-only samples.

known_limits: Nominal .15 mm annulus is not a guaranteed manufactured minimum. Combining .43 mm hole and independent diagonal .075 mm offset against fixed same-layer .60 mm copper gives -.021066 mm stress margin. Manufacturer scope/correlation and actual ring/electrical inspection remain unclosed; no false breakout proof or annulus pass is claimed.
Top mask bridge has only about2.40um over the .10mm nominal target. Exact native/CAM curves and factory mask treatment must be checked; missing mask registration limit remains open.

TI generic guidance describes .20 mm EP-to-lead clearance as satisfactory for most designs. Main rounded EP clearance is .26 mm; corner via lands reduce local GND-to-foreign copper to about.1724 mm. This exceeds the project's .15 mm minimum but is a deliberate thermal-via/process tradeoff, not unchanged TI artwork.

51% is nominal aperture coverage; .02 mm boundary contraction gives about47%, before transfer loss. Geometric avoidance does not prevent reflow wicking into open vias or certify thermal/joint performance.
No charge-current/electrical specification changes are authorized or introduced by this footprint plan. First-board staged charge/load thermal measurements remain required.
implementation_sequence: Read/save native instance snapshot. Verify actual pad numbers and rotation against this coordinate frame.
Edit native perimeter pads1-16 to target positions and rounded RECT shapes, preserving IDs/nets. Edit EP17 to target rounded RECT with no drill.
Remove all17 old TOP paste fills by instance ownership/local geometry. Set outer auto-paste=0; suppress EP auto-paste. Add the one central native paste polygon from this plan.
Create exactly four real ordinary GND through VIA objects at listed centers, copper .60/drill .30, TOP mask+.020/BOTTOM+.050, no paste, no plugging. Add explicit direct EP-to-VSS8 copper.
At final placement/refill, connect solid GND on inner/back planes with the required halo and continuation. Preserve footprint/symbol/device provenance; record instance-only custom geometry revision.

Rerun continuous tolerance on exported artwork, full native DRC and pin/net equivalence. This plan's offline checks are not a CAM pass.
